summary: @servicetitan/responsive preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to the OS tmpdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob using a shuffled string-array with a rotate function and a custom-charset decoder (obfuscator.io shape). The advertised purpose of the package is a React 'Responsive components' UI library, which has no need for a second language runtime or for executing a large obfuscated init script at install time. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a shipped opaque payload bypasses Node-only static scanners; the payload's behavior cannot be verified from source. The chain runs automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
